features: INSTANT STORAGE EXPANSION: Free up space on your phone, tablet, or laptop in seconds. Simply plug in the Lexar Go SSD and transfer files to the drive.

PRORES-READY PERFORMANCE: Capture Apple ProRes 4K 60fps seamless video to the drive with up to 1050MB/s read and 1000MB/s write speeds, letting you shoot video directly to the drive from your iPhone 15 Pro/ Max or above.
DIRECT-CONNECT CONVENIENCE: No dongles, no cables, no hassle. The integrated USB-C connector plugs directly into your device for a clean, streamlined setup wherever you create.
ULTRA-COMPACT DESIGN: Weighing just 13g and measuring only 1.71” x 0.98” x 0.32”, the Lexar Professional GO Portable SSD fits easily in your pocket, so your creative workflow can go anywhere.

BUILT FOR THE JOURNEY: IP65-rated dust and water resistance and drop resistance up to 1 meter help protect your drive from everyday bumps, splashes, and adventures. The included silicone case adds an extra layer of protection wherever you create.

EASY PHOTO BACKUP: Back up photos and videos from your mobile device with the Lexar App, helping you free up space and keep your favorite moments safely stored on your Lexar Professional GO Portable SSD.
UP TO 2TB OF STORAGE: Store thousands of photos, hours of 4K video, and all your essential files without juggling multiple drives.

WIDE COMPATIBILITY: Works seamlessly with iPhones, iPads, Android phones and tablets, Macs, PCs, cameras, and other devices with a USB Type-C port, and is backed by a 5-year warranty for lasting peace of mind.
description: Create more and worry less about running out of space with the Lexar Professional GO Portable SSD. Plug it directly into compatible USB-C devices to instantly expand your storage and keep your mobile setup simple, no cables or dongles needed. Capture Apple ProRes 4K 60fps video directly to the drive from compatible iPhones with up to 1050MB/s read and 1000MB/s write speeds, so you can keep shooting without filling up your phone. Take it anywhere with an ultra-compact design that weighs just 13g and measures only 1.71” x 0.98” x 0.32”, plus IP65-rated dust and water resistance, 1-meter drop resistance, and an included silicone case for added protection on the go. Keep more photos, videos, and essential files close at hand with up to 2TB of storage, and easily back up photos and videos from your mobile device with the Lexar App. With wide compatibility across USB-C phones, tablets, computers, and cameras, the Professional GO helps you capture, back up, store, and move your content wherever creativity takes you.
